observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor event hall or restaurant with tables and seated audience, brightly lit stage area with tiled floor and stage lighting.
observation.dancers: A group of children/youth in mixed gender pairs or lines, approximately 12 dancers.
observation.formation_and_space: Starts in a straight line facing forward, later forms a circle, squats in place, and moves in a single file procession walking in a circle and forming lines.
observation.posture: Upright torso, upright standing or bending knees into squats while maintaining upper body stability.
observation.footwork: Stepping in a line, walking in a circle, and dropping into deep knee bends (squats) while keeping feet planted.
observation.arms_and_hands: Both hands hold small lit candles/trays at chest level while walking and dancing; arms raise higher or extend during squats.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright and relatively still with bending at the knees.
observation.partnering: Dancers move in coordination in a group formation without physical partner contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Transitions between standing upright and squatting low to the floor in unison.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional regional folkloric costumes consisting of embroidered vests, patterned trousers or skirts, headwear/hats, and holding lit candles in small plates or holders.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise footwork details beneath long garments and exact weight transfers are obscured by camera angle and distance.

signature_moments.what: Dancers form a circle and squat down together while holding lit candles aloft
Group drops into unison squats in a long line facing the audience with candles glowing on the floor
